title: ExtensionManifest
description: The manifest a Nimbus connector or extension ships. Contract version v1.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

version.description: Connector version. Deliberately unconstrained beyond non-empty: runContractTests applies no semver check here.

hitlRequired.description: Operations that require human approval before the gateway will run them.

contract.description: The sync contract major; see docs/spec/sync/v1/sync.md.

env.description: The environment variable the gateway injects the credential under. Reserved prefixes and system variables are refused.

credentials.description: Credential name to the environment variable it is injected as; see docs/spec/sync/v1/sync.md section 7. Carries no secret value.

minNimbusVersion.description: Minimum gateway version. Unanchored at the end, so a prerelease suffix is accepted, and tolerant of leading blank characters. Both classes are spelled out to match docs/spec/rules/v1: [\s\u0085] is exactly the blank set (Unicode White_Space plus U+FEFF), since JavaScript's \s omits U+0085 and adds U+FEFF; and [0-9] rather than \d, which is ASCII in JavaScript but Unicode-aware in Python and Rust.

contractVersions.description: The contract majors this connector speaks. Optional in v1; absence means ["1"]. A major names a published spec path segment, so "1" is docs/spec/*/v1/ — unrelated to minNimbusVersion, which is a floor on the gateway product. Spelled [0-9] rather than \d, which is ASCII in JavaScript but Unicode-aware in Python and Rust.
